questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the channel implementations treat the arguments passed to NotificationChannel.send? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Channels are [push, email, sms]. Push's send throws a network error. What happens next?
choices: notify rejects with the network error
The attempt is recorded as retryable and Notifier moves on to email
Notifier retries push until it succeeds
Push is recorded as rejected and no further channels are tried

questions.prompt: A message with priority "low" is sent to a user whose email address is unknown (addressFor returns null). Channels are [email, sms]. What is in the returned report?
choices: channel: null with one rejected email attempt
channel: null and an empty attempts list
It throws because no channel could be used

questions.prompt: The SMS gateway returns status "failed" for a submit. How does that surface through the SendOutcome contract?
choices: As { kind: "retryable" }, so Notifier tries the next channel
As { kind: "rejected" }, so Notifier stops trying further channels
As a thrown error that Notifier logs
As { kind: "delivered" } because the gateway accepted the request
